say:3:1310203001:0.text: We have arrived. Welcome to Cedartown.
say:3:1310203001:0.source_cn: 诸位，到了。这里就是雪松镇。

say:4:1310203002:0.text: Oh, look at that cute snowman! Magister, Chippy wants to make one too!
say:4:1310203002:0.source_cn: 哇，快看，好可爱的雪人啊！主人，满满也想堆一个！
say:4:1310203002:0.male: Oh, look at that cute snowman! Magister, Chippy wants to make one too!
say:4:1310203002:0.female: Oh, look at that cute snowman! Magister, Chippy wants to make one too!

choice_prompt:5:1310203002.text: Oh, look at that cute snowman! Magister, Chippy wants to make one too!
choice_prompt:5:1310203002.source_cn: 哇，快看，好可爱的雪人啊！主人，满满也想堆一个！
choice_prompt:5:1310203002.male: Oh, look at that cute snowman! Magister, Chippy wants to make one too!
choice_prompt:5:1310203002.female: Oh, look at that cute snowman! Magister, Chippy wants to make one too!

say:6:1310203003:1.text: Ahh! Magister called Chippy cute. This is the best day ever!
say:6:1310203003:1.source_cn: 哇，主人夸我可爱！太高兴了！
say:6:1310203003:1.male: Ahh! Magister called Chippy cute. This is the best day ever!
say:6:1310203003:1.female: Ahh! Magister called Chippy cute. This is the best day ever!

say:7:1310203004:1.text: Chippy, keep your composure. People are watching!
say:7:1310203004:1.source_cn: 满满，注意形象，好多人看你呢！

say:8:1310203006:1.text: No need to rush, little familiar. The festival features a delightful snowman-building contest—ample opportunity for you to showcase your talents.
say:8:1310203006:1.source_cn: 别着急，使魔先生，祭典时会有堆雪人的活动，一定能让你一...

say:9:1310203007:1.text: Everyone must be tired from the journey. Perhaps it would be prudent to find a place to rest for a time.
say:9:1310203007:1.source_cn: 大家一路赶来，想必都累了，或许应该找个地方好好休息一下。

say:10:1310203008:1.text: I have a meeting scheduled with the Captain of the Palace Guards regarding the security arrangements for the festival. Please excuse me for now.
say:10:1310203008:1.source_cn: 我得去拜访负责祭典安全的宫廷侍卫长了，还有工作在等着我...

say:11:1310203009:1.text: Mr. Faramor, let's meet again at the festival!
say:11:1310203009:1.source_cn: 法拉莫尔先生，咱们祭典上再见！

say:14:1310203010:0.text: That white wolf is quite the character. Even Hardhead, who's usually quite picky, seems to like that fella!
say:14:1310203010:0.source_cn: 白狼兄弟性格很不错，连一向挑剔的铁头都开始喜欢他了！

say:15:1310203011:1.text: Hey, Whistler, Hardhead, and I think we should take it easy here. Let's grab some food and explore the town.
say:15:1310203011:1.source_cn: 嘿，尖哨和铁头，还有我，都建议我们在雪松镇好好放松一下...

say:16:1310203012:1.text: Chippy wants to explore! It's so clean and beautiful here! Especially compared to Rustport...
say:16:1310203012:1.source_cn: 满满也想好好在镇子里逛一逛，这里又干净又漂亮，满满好喜欢！

say:17:1310203013:1.text: Yes, maybe we'll find some cute souvenirs along the way.
say:17:1310203013:1.source_cn: 对呀，也许还能买到一些漂亮的小纪念品……

say:18:1310203014:1.text: Aha! That's settled then! Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, no objections allowed!
say:18:1310203014:1.male: Aha! That's settled then! Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, no objections allowed!
say:18:1310203014:1.female: Aha! That's settled then! Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, no objections allowed!

say:20:1310203005:1.text: It'll definitely be the cutest snowman in the whole town!
say:20:1310203005:1.source_cn: 那肯定是整个雪松镇最可爱的雪人！
say:20:1310203005:1.male: It'll definitely be the cutest snowman in the whole town!
say:20:1310203005:1.female: It'll definitely be the cutest snowman in the whole town!

say:1:1310204001:0.text: Hello travelers! In this chilly weather, wouldn't you like to warm up with some hot food?
say:1:1310204001:0.source_cn: 各位远道而来的朋友，天气这样寒冷，要不要来吃些热气腾腾...

say:3:1310204002:0.text: Oh! This is my favorite restaurant in all of Cedartown. They've got my favorite dessert bread!
say:3:1310204002:0.source_cn: 哦嚯！这家餐厅可是雪松镇里我最喜欢的地方了。哎呀，有我...

say:4:1310204003:0.text: The bread's covered in syrup and stuffed with fresh berry jam. So good! Here, have a bite.
say:4:1310204003:0.source_cn: 这种裹了糖浆的面包圈里面填满了新鲜浆果做成的果酱，棒极...

say:7:1310204004:0.text: Mhmm, so sweet and tangy. Yummy! Hugin, you sure know your way around Cedartown's food!
say:7:1310204004:0.source_cn: 嗯……唔……酸甜可口，好吃！呼金先生，原来你对雪松镇的...

say:8:1310204005:0.text: Haha! I came here years ago. I didn't make it for the festival, but the food... unforgettable. I remember there was also this stuffed bread...
say:8:1310204005:0.source_cn: 哈！很多年前我来过这里，虽然没赶上祭典，但可是大饱了口...

say:11:1310204006:0.text: You must be talking about our famous savory bread!
say:11:1310204006:0.source_cn: 这位客人，你说的一定是我家餐厅最出名的烤炉面包吧！

say:12:1310204007:0.text: Yes! Fresh out of the oven, topped with sausage, veggies, and cheese. I still dream about that taste...
say:12:1310204007:0.source_cn: 就是它！热乎乎的炉子里现烤出来的、上面堆满了香肠、蔬菜...

say:13:1310204008:0.text: Oh wow... That gooey cheese, the warm bread, and the aroma of those toppings filling my nose. Even Hardhead's drooling!
say:13:1310204008:0.source_cn: 喔……瞧这能拉出丝来的浓香奶酪，配上烤面包的麦香、香肠...

say:16:1310204009:1.text: Mhmm! It's too good! Now if only we had something to drink...
say:16:1310204009:1.source_cn: 唔唔，太好吃了！如果能再有些喝的……

say:17:1310204010:0.text: We've got mushroom and meat stew, or a clear chicken soup with snowradish and frosted celery. Tastes just like home!
say:17:1310204010:0.source_cn: 当然有啦！各种蘑菇和肉炖出来的蘑菇汤，或者是放了雪葱萝...

say:20:1310204011:0.text: A warm bowl in this cold weather? It's just like curling up by a fire!
say:20:1310204011:0.source_cn: 这样寒冷的冬天里喝上一碗，热乎乎，和靠在火炉边睡觉一样舒服！

say:21:1310204012:0.text: It smells amazing! Magister, you gotta try some too!
say:21:1310204012:0.source_cn: 真是、真是太香了！！！主人，你也尝尝！
say:21:1310204012:0.male: It smells amazing! Magister, you gotta try some too!
say:21:1310204012:0.female: It smells amazing! Magister, you gotta try some too!

say:3:1310205001:1.source_cn: 斯瓦夫先生，又见到你啦！

say:4:1310205002:1.text: Dura above, it's you! What a coincidence! I just arrived in Cedartown.
say:4:1310205002:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，是你们！真是巧了，我刚刚才进雪松镇，就又和你...

say:5:1310205003:1.text: Now where's that impressive hunter... Faramor, I believe his name was?
say:5:1310205003:1.source_cn: 那个很厉害的白狼……法拉莫尔呢？

say:6:1310205004:1.text: He's still got work to do, so we parted ways when we got to town.
say:6:1310205004:1.source_cn: 他还有工作要做，刚来雪松镇就和我们分开了。

say:7:1310205005:1.text: I rushed here after helping that family onto a carriage. I haven't even eaten yet, but I didn't wanna miss the opening ceremony.
say:7:1310205005:1.source_cn: 我把那一家三口送上马车就往镇子里跑，饭也顾不上吃，还好...

say:8:1310205006:1.text: Ah, yes! I promised to guide you around town, didn't I?
say:8:1310205006:1.source_cn: 是了，说好了要给你们做向导，带你们逛逛……

choice_prompt:9:1310205006.text: Ah, yes! I promised to guide you around town, didn't I?
choice_prompt:9:1310205006.source_cn: 是了，说好了要给你们做向导，带你们逛逛……

say:10:1310205007:1.text: Yeah, your clothes are as dusty as Chippy's fur was in the Ashen Wastes. You must be exhausted!
say:10:1310205007:1.source_cn: 对呀，你看起来风尘仆仆的，一定累坏了。

say:11:1310205008:1.text: Grab something to eat and rest up.
say:11:1310205008:1.source_cn: 先吃点东西好好休息一下吧。

say:12:1310205011:1.text: Well... if you say so, I won't argue with you.
say:12:1310205011:1.source_cn: 哎呀，这……你们这么说了，我也就不和你们争了。

say:13:1310205012:1.text: But if you need anything, you can find me at the inn over there. It's called the Icy Hearth.
say:13:1310205012:1.source_cn: 你们有需要就来找我，我就住那边的旅馆。喏，叫“雪与火”...

say:16:1310205013:1.text: Alright, see you at the festival!
say:16:1310205013:1.source_cn: 好呀，斯瓦夫先生，咱们祭典上再见！

say:20:1310205009:1.text: It's been years since I've been here, but I've got a good memory!
say:20:1310205009:1.source_cn: 哈，虽然好多年没来了，但我的记性可一向不差！

say:21:1310205010:1.text: I may not be a local, but I can show you guys around just fine.
say:21:1310205010:1.source_cn: 就算没有你那么熟悉，可带他们在镇子里逛一逛还是没问题的。

choice:9:1:2.text: Don't worry, we have a guide.
choice:9:1:2.male: Don't worry, we have a guide.
choice:9:1:2.female: Don't worry, we have a guide.

say:0:1310209001:0.text: Alright, let's head to Artisan Avenue and find Hugin's friends.
say:0:1310209001:0.source_cn: 休息得差不多了，我们去工匠街找呼金的朋友吧。
say:0:1310209001:0.male: Alright, let's head to Artisan Avenue and find Hugin's friends.
say:0:1310209001:0.female: Alright, let's head to Artisan Avenue and find Hugin's friends.

say:1:1310209002:0.text: Yeah. Let's get down to business!

say:0:1310210001:0.text: Has the Hierophant sent anyone yet?
say:0:1310210001:0.source_cn: 白山大主教还没派人来？

say:2:1310210003:0.text: Then how are we gonna make the Ignis Core?!

say:3:1310211001:0.text: Oho, Haldor! You're still lookin' sharp as ever, like a hammer ready for action!
say:3:1310211001:0.source_cn: 哦嚯，老约恩！你看上去还是跟以前一样，像锻锤一样有精神！

say:4:1310211002:0.text: Hugin, about time you show up! You move slower than my sleeping granny. Hurry up! There's no time for chit-chat. We're all pulling double shifts!
say:4:1310211002:0.source_cn: 呼金，你总算是来了！你赶路的速度简直比我奶奶还慢！快点...

say:5:1310211003:0.text: Bless my beard! What kind of job did you take that needs my help and is keeping you from the festival?
say:5:1310211003:0.source_cn: 哎呀呀，你们到底接了什么活儿，叫我来帮忙不说，连祭典都...

say:6:1310211004:0.text: The festival is what we're working for! This year, we're in charge of the hero's ice sculpture. And now, not only is it unfinished, we don't even have the Ignis Core ready!
say:6:1310211004:0.source_cn: 就是为了祭典才赶工的！今年咱们负责给祭典雕刻英雄冰雕。...

choice_prompt:7:1310211004.text: The festival is what we're working for! This year, we're in charge of the hero's ice sculpture. And now, not only is it unfinished, we don't even have the Ignis Core ready!
choice_prompt:7:1310211004.source_cn: 就是为了祭典才赶工的！今年咱们负责给祭典雕刻英雄冰雕。现在倒好，冰雕没雕完不说，连燃芯也没法做了！

say:8:1310211005:0.text: Two thousand years ago, a great general marched her army into battle against the Hypogeans. It was a war of blood and fire, the kind that carves scars into the land itself. So many lives were lost...
say:8:1310211005:0.source_cn: 咳，大概两千年前，这儿有位女将军带领军队与恶魔开战，花...

say:9:1310211006:0.text: And in the end, even the general herself fell... This festival was born to remember that fateful battle, and the price she paid for all of us.
say:9:1310211006:0.source_cn: 那场战争打得天昏地暗，死伤惨重，就连女将军本人最后也牺...

say:10:1310211007:1.text: Umm. That's a really cool story, but what does that have to do with the ice sculpture and the Ignis Core?
say:10:1310211007:1.source_cn: 嗯，故事挺有趣，但……这跟冰雕和燃芯有什么关系呢？

say:11:1310211008:0.text: Let me finish, hamster! The most important ritual of the festival is lighting the sculpture of the general with the "Eternal Flame". To do that, we need a special Ignis Core, made with magic!
say:11:1310211008:0.source_cn: 祭典最重要的仪式是用“不灭的火焰”为女将军的冰雕点火。...

say:12:1310211009:0.text: In the past, the Hierophant would send some acolytes to handle this part, but this year, we haven't heard a thing from the Temple!
say:12:1310211009:0.source_cn: 往年大主教会派修士来负责这项工作，可今年，大修道院那里...

say:13:1310211010:0.text: I heard the Hierophant is really sick... but this is important—someone's gotta take care of it!
say:13:1310211010:0.source_cn: 听说大主教病得很厉害……但这么重要的事，总得有人来做吧！

say:14:1310211011:1.text: Oh, old buddy, I have a surprise for you! My friend over here...
say:14:1310211011:1.source_cn: 嘿，需要用魔法做燃芯？这还不容易！我身边的这位——
say:14:1310211011:1.male: Oh, old buddy, I have a surprise for you! My friend over here...
say:14:1310211011:1.female: Oh, old buddy, I have a surprise for you! My friend over here...

choice_prompt:15:1310211011.text: Oh, old buddy, I have a surprise for you! My friend over here...
choice_prompt:15:1310211011.source_cn: 嘿，需要用魔法做燃芯？这还不容易！我身边的这位——
choice_prompt:15:1310211011.male: Oh, old buddy, I have a surprise for you! My friend over here...
choice_prompt:15:1310211011.female: Oh, old buddy, I have a surprise for you! My friend over here...

say:16:1310211012:0.text: Do you happen to be a mage?
say:16:1310211012:0.male: Do you happen to be a mage?
say:16:1310211012:0.female: Do you happen to be a mage?

say:17:1310211013:1.text: Of course, he's the most powerful mage out there!
say:17:1310211013:1.source_cn: 当然，主人可是最厉害的魔法师！
say:17:1310211013:1.male: Of course, he's the most powerful mage out there!
say:17:1310211013:1.female: Of course, she's the most powerful mage out there!

say:18:1310211017:0.text: I swear on Whistler and Hardhead, this mage is powerful. You're in good hands!
say:18:1310211017:0.source_cn: 尖哨和铁头作证，我可亲眼见识过，这位魔法师大人厉害极了！
say:18:1310211017:0.male: I swear on Whistler and Hardhead, this mage is powerful. You're in good hands!
say:18:1310211017:0.female: I swear on Whistler and Hardhead, this mage is powerful. You're in good hands!

say:19:1310211018:0.text: Fantastic! With you all helping, I've got nothing to worry about!
say:19:1310211018:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上！哈哈，有你们帮忙，我就没什么可发愁的了！

say:20:1310211019:0.text: Hugin, since you're here, you gotta help me with the sculpture. And mage, if you have time, maybe you can track down the materials for the Ignis Core?
say:20:1310211019:0.source_cn: 呼金，既然你来了，就得帮我做雕像。要是这位魔法师大人有...
say:20:1310211019:0.male: Hugin, since you're here, you gotta help me with the sculpture. And mage, if you have time, maybe you can track down the materials for the Ignis Core?
say:20:1310211019:0.female: Hugin, since you're here, you gotta help me with the sculpture. And mage, if you have time, maybe you can track down the materials for the Ignis Core?

say:21:1310211020:0.text: You'll need <style="highlight">lampfish oil</style>, <style="highlight">snow wolf tail hair</style>, and a <style="highlight">firethorn fruit</style>.

say:22:1310211021:0.text: Fish oil, wolf hair, and fruit? What an odd combination...
say:22:1310211021:0.source_cn: 鱼油、狼尾巴毛、植物果实？好奇怪的材料……

say:23:1310211022:0.text: What's so strange about it? Lampfish oil makes the Ignis Core weatherproof. Snow wolf tail hair keeps it strong and long-lasting. The firethorn fruit boosts the magic, making the flame burn forever!
say:23:1310211022:0.source_cn: 这有什么奇怪的！浸过小鳞犬鱼鱼油的燃芯，风雨严寒都奈何...

say:24:1310211023:0.text: Alright, let's get to it! Time's running out!
say:24:1310211023:0.source_cn: 好了，大家加把劲，时间可不等人啊！

say:26:1310211014:0.text: Really? Do you think you could make an Ignis Core?
say:26:1310211014:0.source_cn: 真的？你可以做出魔法燃芯？
say:26:1310211014:0.male: Really? Do you think you could make an Ignis Core?
say:26:1310211014:0.female: Really? Do you think you could make an Ignis Core?

choice_prompt:27:1310211014.text: Really? Do you think you could make an Ignis Core?
choice_prompt:27:1310211014.source_cn: 真的？你可以做出魔法燃芯？
choice_prompt:27:1310211014.male: Really? Do you think you could make an Ignis Core?
choice_prompt:27:1310211014.female: Really? Do you think you could make an Ignis Core?

say:28:1310211015:0.text: Balderdash! Magister Merlin is a legend. Even if you're a mage, there's no way that you're that Merlin!
say:28:1310211015:0.source_cn: 梅林可是传说中的人物，就算你是魔法师，也绝不可能是梅林！
say:28:1310211015:0.male: Balderdash! Magister Merlin is a legend. Even if you're a mage, there's no way that you're that Merlin!
say:28:1310211015:0.female: Balderdash! Magister Merlin is a legend. Even if you're a mage, there's no way that you're that Merlin!

say:29:1310211016:1.text: But he's... Ah, forget it. You're just as stubborn as you were when you were young.
say:29:1310211016:1.source_cn: 这位确实是……嚯，算了，你还是和年轻时候一样固执。
say:29:1310211016:1.male: But he's... Ah, forget it. You're just as stubborn as you were when you were young.
say:29:1310211016:1.female: But she's... Ah, forget it. You're just as stubborn as you were when you were young.

say:0:1310212001:0.text: Nice! This must be a lampfish!
say:0:1310212001:0.source_cn: 钓上来了！这就是“小鳞犬鱼”吧？

say:0:1310213001:0.text: Wolf tail hair... if Faramor were here, we could've gotten it right away.
say:0:1310213001:0.source_cn: 狼尾毛……要是法拉莫尔在的话是不是能直接拿到呢？

say:1:1310213002:0.source_cn: 满满！你的想法太失礼了！

say:0:1310214001:0.text: This is my first time seeing a firethorn fruit.
say:0:1310214001:0.source_cn: 原来这就是血剑果，我也是第一次见呢！

say:0:1310215001:0.text: We've got everything. Let's head back and make that Ignis Core!
say:0:1310215001:0.source_cn: 材料都找齐了，该回去做燃芯了！

say:3:1310216001:0.text: No wonder even Hugin speaks highly of you. You work fast!
say:3:1310216001:0.source_cn: 不愧是连呼金都称赞的魔法师大人，动作可真快！
say:3:1310216001:0.male: No wonder even Hugin speaks highly of you. You work fast!
say:3:1310216001:0.female: No wonder even Hugin speaks highly of you. You work fast!

say:4:1310216002:0.text: You should know that getting Hugin to compliment someone is harder than pulling teeth!
say:4:1310216002:0.source_cn: 要知道呼金这家伙，让他夸人一句可比登天还难！

say:5:1310216003:0.text: Hah, old friend, I'm not that thoughtless, am I? Now, let's get to making the Ignis Core!
say:5:1310216003:0.source_cn: 嚯嚯，老伙计，铁头作证，我可没那么吝啬。行了，快告诉他...

say:6:1310216004:0.text: First, mix the snow wolf's tail hair with cotton and weave it into a wick. Then, soak it in a mix of lampfish oil and firethorn fruit pulp and wait for it to harden.
say:6:1310216004:0.source_cn: 先用棉纱混合雪狼的韧尾毛编织芯线，然后在小鳞犬鱼鱼油和...

say:7:1310216005:0.text: Finally, and this is the most important part, use magic to stabilize the core so it shines without producing enough heat to melt the ice!
say:7:1310216005:0.source_cn: 最后也是最重要的，用魔法处理整个燃芯，让它能够稳定散发...

say:8:1310216006:0.text: Well, I have no idea how magic works, so I'm counting on you!

say:9:1310207005:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，你把它脱下来给我，咱们就两清了！

say:12:1310207007:0.text: So you'll accept this bracelet as payment? Sure, here you go!
say:12:1310207007:0.source_cn: 用这条裙子就可以抵清？好的呀，我这就脱下来给你！

choice_prompt:13:1310207007.text: So you'll accept this bracelet as payment? Sure, here you go!
choice_prompt:13:1310207007.source_cn: 用这条裙子就可以抵清？好的呀，我这就脱下来给你！

say:14:1310207008:0.text: H-hey, who are you? What's this got to do with you?
say:14:1310207008:0.source_cn: 嗯？你什么人啊？关你什么事？
say:14:1310207008:0.male: H-hey, who are you? What's this got to do with you?
say:14:1310207008:0.female: H-hey, who are you? What's this got to do with you?

say:15:1310207009:0.text: How could you be trying to swindle a sweet girl like her?!
say:15:1310207009:0.source_cn: 你！你怎么能让她这样当众脱衣服？

say:18:1310207010:0.text: The audacity! And that bracelet is worth more than your whole shop!
say:18:1310207010:0.source_cn: 一点都不尊重人！而且这件衣服的价值都足够买下你的店铺了！

say:19:1310207013:0.text: Mind your own business, outsider! A deal's a deal!
say:19:1310207013:0.source_cn: 外乡人，少多管闲事！这小姑娘自己都答应把裙子抵给我了，...

choice_prompt:20:1310207013.text: Mind your own business, outsider! A deal's a deal!
choice_prompt:20:1310207013.source_cn: 外乡人，少多管闲事！这小姑娘自己都答应把裙子抵给我了，你们凑什么热闹！

say:21:1310207014:0.text: I won't accept a single coin less!
say:21:1310207014:0.source_cn: 你把钱拿出来再说话，我跟你说，一分都不能少！

choice_prompt:22:1310207014.text: I won't accept a single coin less!
choice_prompt:22:1310207014.source_cn: 你把钱拿出来再说话，我跟你说，一分都不能少！

say:23:1310207015:0.source_cn: 这些够了吧？主人才不会少给你的！

say:24:1310207017:0.text: Grrr... Alright, fine. This'll do. You can go...
say:24:1310207017:0.source_cn: 让我数数……嗯，这还差不多，行了行了，你们走吧。

say:27:1310207018:0.text: I'm so sorry you all had to pay for me... I totally don't have anything to repay you... unless... maybe this cute bracelet?
say:27:1310207018:0.source_cn: 让你们替我付钱真是不好意思，我身上没什么能补偿你们的…...

say:29:1310207019:0.text: No no no! We can't take that! Consider the meal our treat!
say:29:1310207019:0.source_cn: 啊？不不不，这……这可不能啊！哎呀，就算我们请客！

say:30:1310207020:0.text: Haha, I was just kidding! But really, thank you all so much. You're such kind people!
say:30:1310207020:0.source_cn: 哈哈，我开玩笑的。总之，我要谢谢你们，你们都是很好很好的人！

say:37:1310208002:0.text: Shh! I told you not to call me that when we're out!
say:37:1310208002:0.source_cn: 嘘！都说了出门不要这么叫……

say:38:1310208003:0.text: Ahem... Miss Yolena, running around like this isn't safe. If your father finds out, he's going to be furious...
say:38:1310208003:0.source_cn: 咳……亚莲娜小姐，这样到处乱跑很不安全，您父亲知道了会...

say:39:1310208004:0.text: Oh, come on! It's fine just this once!
say:39:1310208004:0.source_cn: 哎呀，没关系的，就这一次嘛。

say:40:1310208005:0.text: Ugh, pleeeease, Rodrigo! Don't tell him. I'm begging you!
say:40:1310208005:0.source_cn: 拜托了，罗德里戈，不要告诉我父亲好不好？求你了……

say:41:1310208006:0.text: But... *Sigh* Alright. Still, your father's going to arrive in Cedartown soon.
say:41:1310208006:0.source_cn: 可是……唉，好吧。不过您父亲很快就要抵达雪松镇了……

say:42:1310208007:0.text: Ugh, I know, I know... I really don't want him mad at me...
say:42:1310208007:0.source_cn: 父亲……唉，好吧。我也不想让他生气呀。

say:44:1310208008:0.text: Heyyy, my new friends! Let's totally hang out again at the festival, okay?
say:44:1310208008:0.source_cn: 几位可爱的朋友，咱们祭典的时候再一起玩吧！

narration:52:13010214:0.text: In front of a shop, a lady who has forgotten her purse is stopped by the owner.

narration:53:13010214:0.text: In front of a shop, a lady who has forgotten her purse is stopped by the owner.

say:54:1310207016:0.text: We won't allow you to bully this girl any longer! We'll cover her bill.

say:58:1310207012:0.text: Your bracelet is far more valuable than the meal you just had. You shouldn't hand it over so easily!
